generator.shared_prompt_contract: Four matched phases: inbound bolt, peak contact, recoil starburst, dissipating fragments. Centered isolated magical lightning effect; crisp 16-bit SNES-era pixel art; hard square pixels; dark navy outline; flat clusters; gold, pale gold, white, steel blue and cyan palette intent; no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur, bloom, semitransparent fringe, character, scenery, UI, text, logo, circle, card or shadow; readable after nearest-neighbor reduction to 32x32.

steps: remove temporary magenta and alpha below 128
drop disconnected components smaller than 256 source pixels
square-pad the surviving subject with six-percent margin
nearest-neighbor sample to 28x28 and center on transparent 32x32
hard-alpha threshold and nearest TD32-subset palette remap

qa.palette: TD32 subset; exact SKY excluded; exact WHITE intentionally reserved as the impact probe signal
